title: MinecraftMOBA
description: LOL-style MOBA PvP plugin with towers, minions, shop, and level system
body:
# MinecraftMOBA - LOL-style MOBA PvP

> ⚠️ **Alpha Version** - Core features implemented. Combat system, tower attacks, and win conditions are in development.

A MOBA (Multiplayer Online Battle Arena) plugin inspired by League of Legends. Two teams compete to destroy the enemy's core.

## Features

### Team Battle
- **2 Teams** - RED vs BLUE battles
- **5v5 Support** - Up to 5 players per team
- **Auto Balance** - Prevents uneven teams
- **Game States** - Waiting → Starting → In-Game → Ending

### Structures
- **Core** - Main objective (1000 HP), destroy to win
- **Towers** - 5 defensive towers per team (300 HP each)
- **Tower Protection** - Core attackable only after all towers destroyed

### Minion System
- **Auto Spawning** - Every 30 seconds
- **3 Lanes** - Top, Mid, Bot support
- **2 Types** - Melee (Zombie) and Ranged (Skeleton)
- **Scaling** - Get stronger over time

### Economy System
- **Emerald Currency** - Earn from kills and objectives
- **Passive Income** - 5E every 10 seconds
- **Death Penalty** - Lose 10% on death
- **Tower Bonus** - 25E for destruction

### Level System
- **18 Levels** - Max level cap
- **Stat Growth** - +2 HP, +10% damage per level
- **XP Sources** - Minions, players, assists, passive

### Shop System
- **GUI Shop** - Inventory-based
- **Weapons** - Wood → Stone → Iron → Diamond
- **Armor** - Iron set with protection
- **Potions** - Speed, Strength, Healing
- **Utility** - Wards, Golden Apples

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/moba join` | Join game | `moba.player` |
| `/moba leave` | Leave game | `moba.player` |
| `/moba stats` | View stats | `moba.player` |
| `/shop` | Open shop | `moba.shop` |
| `/moba start` | Start game | `moba.admin` |
| `/moba stop` | Stop game | `moba.admin` |
| `/moba reload` | Reload config | `moba.admin` |

## Permissions

| Permission | Default |
|------------|---------|
| `moba.player` | true |
| `moba.shop` | true |
| `moba.admin` | op |

## Requirements
- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 21+

---

## 日本語 (Japanese)

LOL風のMOBA PvPプラグインです。

**基本システム:** 2チーム対戦（RED vs BLUE）、最大5v5。敵のコアを破壊すれば勝利。

**構造物:** コア（HP1000）とタワー5本（各HP300）。全タワー破壊後にコア攻撃可能。

**ミニオン:** 30秒ごとに3レーンにスポーン。時間経過で強化。

**経済:** エメラルド通貨。ミニオン・プレイヤーキルで獲得、デスで10%喪失。

**レベル:** 最大Lv18。レベルごとにHP+2、攻撃力+10%。

**ショップ:** GUI形式。武器・防具・ポーション・ワード購入可能。

⚠️ **α版:** 戦闘イベント・タワー攻撃・勝敗判定は開発中

**Discord:** https://discord.gg/zYY55dzhjd
